title: [TEXT - The main package title, e.g. Μαρόκο 9 Ημέρες]
subtitle: [TEXT - Subtitle displayed under the title on the single page]
card_subtitle: [TEXT - Short subtitle shown on the package card grid, e.g. 9 ημέρες / 7 νύχτες]
badge_text: [TEXT - Custom badge text on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Country name]
card_primary_tag: [TEXT - Custom first tag on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Holiday term]
card_secondary_tag: [TEXT - Custom second tag on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Category term]
price_note: [TEXT - Note under price, e.g. τελική τιμή ανά άτομο με φόρους]
expiration_date: [DATE string in YYYY-MM-DD format - Package automatically hides after this date, e.g. 2026-10-31]
description_content:
[HTML - The main descriptive daily program / itinerary. Use standard paragraph (

), bold (), and italic () tags]
includes_content:
[HTML - List of included services. Must be formatted as an HTML list:
  • Item 1
  • Item 2
]
excludes_content:
[HTML - List of excluded services. Must be formatted as an HTML list:
  • Item 1
  • Item 2
]
general_info_content: [HTML - Flight info, luggage limits, hotel notes, entry requirements, etc.]
